Leveling, tone, and how a podcast sits over the music

Every song and episode is measured once and played at one fixed gain that brings it to the target loudness, never pushed into clipping. While a podcast plays over music, the music drops by the mixing factor and the two are pulled apart in frequency, so the voice sits in a gap. With only one playing, there is no mixing factor and no separation. Changes ramp in over the ramp time.
Which folders the songs come from
Only folders with audio in them are listed. Uncheck a folder to leave it, and everything in it, out of the library. Folders added later are in unless they’re inside an unchecked one.
Folders show up here once the library has been scanned. Open the dial and allow access to your music first.

Tone for the music and for podcasts

A ten-band tone control for each stream, always on and flat by default. Drag a band up or down, double-tap it for flat, or tap its figure to type one. Boosts are taken back off the overall level, so nothing clips. Music covers everything on the music player, episodes on The Voice and music podcasts included; Podcasts covers shows played over music.
How a podcast and the music are pulled apart (developer mode)

While a podcast plays over music, this shapes both so the voice sits in a gap in the music. Pick a module, then set its figures; each module keeps its own. A change ramps over the ramp time, never snapping. With only one stream playing, it does nothing.
Out of range (%1$s to %2$s), or a low edge isn’t below its high edge.
The podcast through a band pass, the music through a wider, partial notch on the same centre.
Per-band offsets on the equalizer’s ten bands, added to each stream’s tone curve. A voice-forward tilt rather than a true band pass.
Out of range. Mixing factor 0–30 dB, target 8–30 LUFS below full scale, ramp 0–10 s.
Developer mode is on. Settings now has a Debug page, and Podcasts has the gap between episodes.
Podcast folder, and how podcasts play on the channels
Each show’s channels, speed, priority and Pause music are on the podcast page.
Audio files in this folder, and the folders inside it, play as one podcast show instead of songs. It’s on the podcast page, oldest file first, and stays off the music channels.
How long the music runs between podcast episodes on a music channel. Pick a rule, then set its figures; each rule keeps its own. Music podcasts (Pause music on) always wait for the song to end.
